title: Thinkspace Thought — complete demo walkthrough
scope: Full Thought workflow: list access, create meeting, return to list and Open workspace, canvas context menu (child/parent/sibling/edit/delete), comments and actions from canvas and logs panel, materials upload/preview/edit/delete, export, AI summary, analytics, RSVP, list log modals, cleanup (sections A–H).
prerequisites: Optional: E2E_DEMO_PAUSE_MS (default 1200) for headed video pacing

crudSummary.Create: Create meeting → Open workspace → canvas nodes (child/parent/sibling) → comments → actions (canvas + logs) → materials upload
crudSummary.Read: List, Open link, search, logs modals, dock panels, material preview, analytics, export
crudSummary.Update: Node labels, comments, RSVP, undo/redo, material edit preview, contributors panel
crudSummary.Delete: Canvas node delete, material delete, meeting cleanup via API
